'''Nahuel Quetzal Carabaña Valenzuela''' (born 10 November 1999) is an Andorran runner specialising in the [[3000 metres steeplechase]].<ref>{{iaaf name|14759730}}</ref> He is the [[2023 Games of the Small States of Europe]] champion in the 3000 metres steeplechase. He is the [[2022 Ibero-American Championships in Athletics|2022 Ibero-American Championships]] and 2017 and 2019 Games of the Small States of Europe silver medalist in the 3000 metres steeplechase and the 2023 Games of the Small States of Europe silver medalist in [[5000 metres]]. He is the [[List of Andorran records in athletics|national record holder]] in [[3000 metres]], 5000 metres, [[10,000 metres]], and 3000 metres steeplechase.

==Early life==
Carabaña was born on 10 November 1999, in [[Andorra la Vella]], to a Spanish father and an Argentine mother.<ref name="paris2024"/><ref name="runnersworld">{{Cite web|url=https://www.runnersworld.com/es/noticias-running/a40909951/nahuel-carabana-tras-pararse-para-ayudar-a-un-companero-me-ha-salido-del-corazon/|title=Nahuel Carabaña, tras pararse para ayudar a un compañero: "Me ha salido del corazón"|trans-title=Nahuel Carabaña, after stopping to help a colleague: "It came from my heart."|date=16 August 2022|last1=Pérez|first1=Ismael|website=Runner's World}}</ref>

== Career ==
Carabaña won the silver medal in 3000 metres steeplechase at the [[2017 Games of the Small States of Europe]].<ref>{{cite web |last1=Etchells |first1=Daniel |title=Cyprus show quality on busy day of athletics at Games of the Small States of Europe |url=https://www.insidethegames.biz/articles/1051038/cyprus-show-quality-on-busy-day-of-athletics-at-games-of-the-small-states-of-europe |website=[[Inside the Games]] |access-date=6 April 2025 |date=1 June 2017}}</ref> He then repeated this result at the [[2019 Games of the Small States of Europe]], where he also finished fourth in the 10,000 metres race.<ref>{{cite web |title=Games of the Small States of Europe Montenegro 2019 Results Book |url=https://www.montenegro2019.me/images/Results_Bar_29_30_and_31_May_2019.pdf |website=Montenegro 2019 |access-date=6 April 2025 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20190601102944/https://www.montenegro2019.me/images/Results_Bar_29_30_and_31_May_2019.pdf |archive-date=1 June 2019 |pages=16, 22 |url-status=dead}}</ref>

Carabaña won the bronze medal in [[2021 European Athletics U23 Championships – Men's 3000 metres steeplechase|3000 metres steeplechase]] at the [[2021 European Athletics U23 Championships|2021 European U23 Championships]], marking the first time Andorra had won a medal at the European U23 Championships.<ref>{{cite web |title=Italy tops the medal table in Tallinn with a final day gold rush |url=https://www.european-athletics.com/news/italy-tops-the-medal-table-in-tallinn-with-a-final-day-gold-rush |website=[[European Athletics]] |access-date=6 April 2025 |date=11 July 2021}}</ref> He then won a silver medal in the same event at the [[2022 Ibero-American Championships in Athletics|2022 Ibero-American Championships]], setting a new national record in the process.<ref>{{cite web |title=Nahuel Carabaña es penja la medalla de plata als iberoamericans d'Alacant |trans-title=Nahuel Carabaña wins the silver medal at the Ibero-American Games in Alicante |url=https://www.diariandorra.ad/esports/220521/nahuel-carabana-penja-medalla-plata-als-iberoamericans-alacant_104069.html |website=[[Diari d'Andorra]] |access-date=6 April 2025 |language=Catalan |date=21 May 2022}}</ref>

Carabaña competed in the [[2022 European Athletics Championships – Men's 3000 metres steeplechase|3000 metres steeplechase]] at the [[2022 European Athletics Championships|2022 European Championships]]. During the heats, Danish athlete [[Axel Vang Christensen]] was injured during the race. Carabaña turned around to help Vang Christensen move off the course; Carabaña finished the race in last place and received a standing ovation from the crowd.<ref name="runnersworld"/><ref>{{cite web |last1=Poggi |first1=Alessandro |title=Heartwarming sportsmanship displayed by Andorran steeplechase runner at 2022 European athletics championships in Munich |url=https://www.olympics.com/en/news/heartwarming-sportmanship-andorran-steeplechase-runner-euros-athletics |website=[[International Olympic Committee]] |access-date=6 April 2025 |date=16 August 2022}}</ref> He received a World Fair Play Award from the [[International Fair Play Committee]].<ref>{{cite web |title=Fair Play Award at Multisport European Championships Munich 2022 |url=https://www.fairplayinternational.org/fair-play-award-at-multisport-european-championshipsmunich-2022 |website=[[International Fair Play Committee]] |date=27 August 2022 |access-date=6 April 2025}}</ref>

At the [[2023 Games of the Small States of Europe]], Carabaña won the gold medal in the 3000 metres steeplechase and the silver medal in the 5000 metres.<ref>{{cite web |title=Carabaña, Viñals i Huerta, les tres darreres medalles |trans-title=Carabaña, Viñals and Huerta, the last three medals |url=https://www.diariandorra.ad/esports/230604/carabana-vinals-huerta-les-tres-darreres-medalles_125227.html |website=[[Diari d'Andorra]] |access-date=6 April 2025 |date=4 June 2024 |language=Catalan}}</ref> He made his World Championships debut in [[2023 World Athletics Championships|2023]] but did not advance beyond the heats.<ref name="paris2024" /><ref>{{cite web |title=Nahuel Carabaña, eliminat del Mundial de Budapest |trans-title=Nahuel Carabaña, eliminated from the World Championships in Budapest |url=https://elperiodic.ad/esports/nahuel-carabana-eliminat-del-mundial-de-budapest/ |website=El Periòdic d'Andorra |access-date=6 April 2025 |language=Catalan |date=19 August 2023}}</ref> He placed seventh in the [[2024 European Athletics Championships – Men's 3000 metres steeplechase|3000 metres steeplechase final]] at the [[2024 European Athletics Championships|2024 European Championships]].<ref>{{cite web |last1=Gunston |first1=Jo |title=European Athletics Championships 2024: All track and field and road race results |url=https://www.olympics.com/en/news/european-athletics-championships-2024-all-track-field-road-race-results-medals-table |website=[[International Olympic Committee]] |access-date=6 April 2025 |date=7 June 2024}}</ref> This was the first time an Andorran athlete reached a final at the European Athletics Championships.<ref>{{cite web |title=Roma 2024 by the numbers |url=https://www.european-athletics.com/news/roma-2024-by-the-numbers |website=[[European Athletics]] |access-date=6 April 2025 |date=14 June 2024}}</ref>

Carabaña set a new national record in the 3000 metres steeplechase at the 2024 International Marseille Meeting with a time of 8:16.04.<ref>{{cite web |last1=Varona |first1=Alfredo |title=En un país de 80.000 habitantes como Andorra, existe Nahuel Carabaña |trans-title=In a country of 80,000 inhabitants like Andorra, there is Nahuel Carabaña |url=https://www.labolsadelcorredor.com/en-un-pais-de-80-000-habitantes-como-andorra-existe-nahuel-carabana/ |website=La Bolsa del Corredor |access-date=6 April 2025 |language=es |date=23 May 2024}}</ref> He qualified to compete in the 3000 metres steeplechase at the [[2024 Summer Olympics]] through his world ranking.<ref>{{cite web |title=Nahuel Carabaña classificat pels Jocs Olímpics de París |trans-title=Nahuel Carabaña qualified for the Paris Olympic Games |url=https://www.andorraesportiu.com/oficial-nahuel-carabana-classificat-pels-jocs-olimpics-de-paris/ |website=Andorra Esportiu |access-date=6 April 2025 |language=Catalan |date=2 July 2024}}</ref> As one of only two [[Andorra at the 2024 Summer Olympics|Andorran athletes at the Games]], he was a flagbearer in the [[2024 Summer Olympics opening ceremony|opening ceremony]].<ref>{{cite web |last1=Escolá |first1=Marc |title=Doria i Carabaña ja es preparen per a la cerimònia inaugural dels Jocs Olímpics de París |trans-title=Doria and Carabaña are already preparing for the opening ceremony of the Olympic Games in Paris |url=https://www.altaveu.com/actualitat/esport/doria-carabana-ja-es-preparen-cerimonia-inaugural-jocs-olimpics-paris_59134_102.html |website=Altaveu |access-date=6 April 2025 |language=Catalan |date=23 July 2024}}</ref> He failed to advance to the final after finishing seventh in his heat.<ref>{{cite web |title=Nahuel Carabaña, setè i a tres segons d'accedir a la final |trans-title=Nahuel Carabaña, seventh and three seconds from reaching the final |url=https://elperiodic.ad/esports/nahuel-carabana-sete-i-a-tres-segons-daccedir-a-la-final/ |website=El Periòdic d'Andorra |access-date=6 April 2025 |language=Catalan |date=5 August 2024}}</ref>
